It is important to note that as a baselie NO POLICY is configured by default, there are no bandwidth associations as indicated by the LSPs that are being signaled by LSR1 and LSR4 and the controller doesw not know of any policy being set up, their state for policy caches remain empty during startup

This is the output when the `active-pair-policy-entry` field in the CSA YANG model is queried upon startup
```XML
<controller-state xmlns="urn:sma:sdn:csa"/> 
```

This is the output when the `directional-policy-evidence-entry` field is queried at startup too

```XML
<controller-state xmlns="urn:sma:sdn:csa"/>
```

In this case, the application itself does not know of any directional policies, and the underlyign topology has not configured anything else for that matter
